QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] Tabula Rasa
QuestInfo.0: Despite having shared your colors with the villagers, they have somehow returned to their previous, color-less state!\r\nTalk to #p9400221# and find out what happened.
QuestInfo.1: #p9400221# says the residents of the Land of Contemplation had their colors washed away by the rain.\r\n#p9400221# is not surprised, but regrets how disappointed the others have become.\r\nSince you can always recover your own colors, why not share your colors with the people of the villagers again?
QuestInfo.2: The residents of The Land of Contemplation lost their colors to the rain. Sharing your own colors with them, caused you to lose your colors.\r\nYou should go back to #p9400222# and ask them to paint you again!
